body: Quick pass (M5): the body is complete (design choices, verification: actionlint, YAML, `gate batch --dry-run`, both scripts run against a fake gh; not exercised: a real run on the runner, which needs a push to main after merge; `Changelog: none`; `Fixes #1451`). #1451 is P4 (not paused). Stacked on #1418, which must merge first (it currently conflicts with main). Process files are touched, so PROCESS_VERSION is bumped (settled at merge). Flagged ready; a review by the other session is next, with needs-maintainer expected (.github).

Review findings fixed in 58b37bf4 (on top of f535eb10).

**Blockers**
1. Priority now follows AGENTS.md "Priorities" (P1..P9; P0 is retired). The rolling issue is filed as `P2` ("a gate on main is red"). It is `P1` only when a failing suite is a wrong-output suite. An open issue that later fails an output suite is relabelled with `--add-label P1 --remove-label P2`. The script never lowers a priority. Nothing uses `P0` any more. AGENTS.md ("Fixes are tested in the background") and `docs/decisions/1451-post-merge-gate.md` say the same; the decision file records that AGENTS.md governs over the issue's P1/P0 wording.
2. The escalation match is anchored. Suite names come from the FAIL rows' `failed: tests/<name>.rs` notes (`xtask/src/exec.rs` `read_log`), and each whole name is matched against an anchored list, `OUTPUT_SUITES`, documented in the script. The list was taken from `cargo xtask gate batch --dry-run`:
   - app: golden_cl, solid_law_goldens, recorded_post_streams, posting, post_cycle_feed_spindle, and the `*_post` NC golden suites (carvera, grblhal, lathe and its css/g76/inch/tormach/tormach_thread variants, plasma, tinyg, tormach, wire)
   - post: recorded_streams, post_engine, fanuc_post, doosan_dnm_post, inverted_post, `script_<dialect>`

   The step names ("post suites"), `unittests`, compile errors and words like "compost" never escalate.

**Notes taken**
- The open-issue search adds `--label source:agent`, so a green run only comments on and closes an agent-filed issue.
- Concurrency group: `post-merge-${{ github.event_name == 'push' && 'main' || inputs.ref || 'main' }}`. A non-main dispatch no longer cancels main's gate. An empty-ref dispatch stays in the main group.

**Tests** (fake-gh harness, which logs every call and honours the `--label` filter):

| Case | Result |
|---|---|
| red `tests/stock_sim.rs`, nothing open | create `P2` |
| red `golden_cl`, nothing open | create `P1` |
| red `script_fanuc`, nothing open | create `P1` |
| red `recorded_post_streams` + `sim`, open #42 | comment + `--add-label P1 --remove-label P2` |
| red non-output suite, open #42 | comment only, no relabel |
| post crate `unittests` red | `P2` |
| `tests/compost.rs`, `tests/post_not_judged.rs` | `P2` |
| post step compile error | `P2` |
| near misses `xgolden_cl`, `golden_cl_old` | `P2` |
| green, open `source:agent` #42 | comment + close |
| green, same title without `source:agent` | nothing touched |
| green, nothing open | nothing |

Other checks: actionlint on `post-merge.yml` is clean, the YAML parses (Ruby), and `bash -n` passes. shellcheck is not installed here.

**Conflicts:** the conflict with main comes from #1418 (AGENTS.md and PROCESS_VERSION). Main was deliberately not merged in here. It clears once #1418 is refreshed and merged.

Ready for a re-review.

Back to draft: merging the refreshed #1418 head (24dd4a33, which now contains main) to clear the inherited conflict. Will re-flag ready after the merge is pushed and gated. needs-rework stays for M3's re-review.

Merged the refreshed #1418 head (24dd4a33, which contains main) to clear the inherited conflict (merge commit f2742cd0). Resolved: `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` -> 62 (#1418 takes 61; this branch had 61, which git kept silently, so it was bumped in the merge). AGENTS.md merged cleanly, #1454's additions on top of #1418's. Targeted gate: `cargo test -p xtask` 113 passed; clippy -D warnings clean; `bash -n` on .github/scripts/post-merge-{report,skip}.sh ok; actionlint on cut.yml + post-merge.yml clean. mergeable: MERGEABLE. needs-rework left in place for M3's re-review of the fix head plus this merge. Ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: f2742cd08ccb6c41627e8800dd5ca93522dc8497 -->
**Delta re-review @ f2742cd0** (fix 58b37bf4 plus the merge of #1418's refreshed head): **no blockers.** Read, not built (`.github`), so `needs-maintainer`.

1. **Priorities, fixed.**
   - P2 by default; P1 only when a failing suite is in the anchored `OUTPUT_SUITES` list.
   - An open issue is escalated with `--add-label P1 --remove-label P2` and is never lowered. No P0 anywhere.
   - AGENTS.md and `docs/decisions/1451-post-merge-gate.md` say the same.
2. **Matching is anchored, fixed.**
   - Suite stems are taken from xtask's `failed: tests/<name>.rs` FAIL-row notes (`xtask/src/exec.rs:259`) and matched with `^(...)$`.
   - Every named suite exists on the head as `crates/*/tests/<name>.rs`, and there are 15 `script_<dialect>` suites. No suite here is a directory suite, so the `tests/<name>.rs` regex reaches them all.
   - Note for later: if an output suite ever moves to `tests/<name>/main.rs` (#1441's directory form), extend the regex, or it falls to P2 silently.
3. **Non-blocking notes, taken.**
   - The close and comment search now requires `source:agent`.
   - Concurrency is keyed on the ref, so a non-main dispatch never cancels main's gate.
- The merge brings #1418's head 24dd4a33 unchanged (delta-checked clean separately). PROCESS_VERSION 62 sits above #1418's 61 and main's 60.
- GitHub reports MERGEABLE.
Back to draft for a small follow-up on the review note: `post-merge-report.sh` will also read directory test suites (`tests/<name>/main.rs`, since PROCESS_VERSION 60) from the gate summary.

Pushed ed21da14: suite names now come from both `tests/<name>.rs` and `tests/<name>/main.rs` (xtask `read_log` prints cargo's `Running <path>`; `/main` is stripped, whole-name anchoring unchanged).

Fake-gh harness: dir `golden_cl/main.rs` -> P1; dir `stock_sim/main.rs` -> P2; dir `script_fanuc/main.rs` -> P1; dir `golden_cl_extra/main.rs` -> P2; file `golden_cl.rs` -> P1; file `stock_sim.rs` -> P2; `compost.rs` -> P2; mixed list with a dir output suite -> P1; open issue + dir output suite -> P1 relabel. `bash -n` ok; actionlint on post-merge.yml clean.

Ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ed21da140206cb0a2277eab07c395558a6ff9541 -->
**Delta re-check @ ed21da14** (one regex in `post-merge-report.sh` since f2742cd0): **no blockers.** `needs-maintainer` stays.

- `tests/<name>(/main)?.rs` is stripped to `<name>`, so a directory suite still meets the anchored `OUTPUT_SUITES` by its whole name.
- Checked by hand:
  - `tests/golden_cl/main.rs` → `golden_cl`;
  - `tests/stock_sim/main.rs, tests/fanuc_post.rs` → `stock_sim fanuc_post`;
  - `tests/golden_cl_extra/main.rs` → `golden_cl_extra`, which stays P2 under the `^(...)$` anchor.
- Nothing else changed.
